obernants.domain: Finite slices T:Eq under reflexive symmetric transitive stable equality, sufficient memory; output usize.
obernants.operator: Given length n and observed k, compatible inputs are equality patterns admitting a palindromic index subsequence of size k and none larger. For an alphabet with at least n symbols: n=0 allows only k=0; n>0 allows precisely 1<=k<=n, witnessed by k copies of one symbol and n-k distinct other symbols. With smaller fixed alphabets extra constraints apply. Actual symbols and order are not uniquely recovered.
obernants.assumptions: Stable Eq semantics where relevant; successful allocation; ordinary Rust execution.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Exact mathematical target; finite evidence does not establish a universal proof.
